name: ShinyHunters
description: ShinyHunters re-emerged in mid-2025 with a materially different playbook focused on vishing, Salesforce OAuth flow abuse, and data extortion without encryption. Tracked alongside Scattered Spider and LAPSUS$ as part of the broader SLSH (Scattered Lapsus$ Hunters) collective. Claimed over 1.5 billion Salesforce records stolen from 760 companies via the Salesforce Aura Campaign (Sept 2025â€“Mar 2026). Arrests in June 2024 temporarily disrupted but did not eliminate the group.

detection_opportunities: New MFA device enrollment following login from unusual geolocation
OAuth app consent grants to unknown or newly registered applications
Anomalous Salesforce Aura API endpoint access (/s/sfsites/aura)
Bulk Salesforce record queries outside business hours from new IPs
Email flood campaigns preceding helpdesk calls (vishing pre-indicator)
Mullvad VPN IP ranges in outbound exfiltration traffic
response_playbook: Review Entra ID/Okta logs for new MFA device enrollments following anomalous logins or vishing-style helpdesk calls.
Audit OAuth app consent grants for unrecognized or newly registered applications with broad mail/file scopes.
Check Salesforce event logs for anomalous /s/sfsites/aura API access and bulk record exports outside business hours.
Inspect connected data-warehouse integrations (Snowflake, BigQuery, Anodot) for token misuse and downstream pivoting.
Flag outbound traffic to Mullvad VPN ranges as a possible exfiltration channel.
Brief executives and staff on possible follow-on harassment/extortion contact (including swatting threats) and loop in physical security.
